import hashlib, os
from pathlib import Path
SUCC = Path("/tmp/opensip-design-corrections/target-identity-successor.v1")
FROZEN = Path("/tmp/opensip-design-corrections/candidate-subject.v24")
MANIFEST_PATHS = {
"docs/coop/design-corrections/foundation/atom-evaluation-contract.v1.md",
"docs/coop/design-corrections/foundation/atom_model.v1.py",
"docs/coop/design-corrections/foundation/check-atoms.v1.py",
"docs/coop/design-corrections/foundation/check-execution-inputs.v1.py",
"docs/coop/design-corrections/foundation/check-semantic-replay.v3.py",
"docs/coop/design-corrections/foundation/evaluator-projection-registry.v1.json",
"docs/coop/design-corrections/foundation/evaluator_semantic_fixture.v3.py",
"docs/coop/design-corrections/foundation/execution-inputs-contract.v1.md",
"docs/coop/design-corrections/foundation/execution_inputs_model.v1.py",
"docs/coop/design-corrections/foundation/identity-model.v3.py",
"docs/coop/design-corrections/foundation/identity-schemas.v3.json",
"docs/coop/design-corrections/foundation/shared-profile-decisions.v1.md",
"docs/coop/design-corrections/foundation/target-attribution.schema.v2.json",
"docs/coop/design-corrections/workflows/check-query-projection.v3.py",
"docs/coop/design-corrections/workflows/query-projection-contract.v3.md",
"docs/coop/design-corrections/workflows/query_projection_model.v3.py",
"docs/v2/contracts/product-v1/identity-and-evidence.md",
"docs/v2/contracts/product-v1/native-evidence.md",
}

def sha(p):
    h=hashlib.sha256()
    with open(p,'rb') as f:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(1024*1024), b''):
            h.update(chunk)
    return h.hexdigest()

succ_files=set()
frozen_files=set()
for root, dirs, files in os.walk(SUCC):
    # skip huge review histories? user said no unrelated review histories but we need to know if successor has extra changes
    for fn in files:
        p=Path(root)/fn
        rel=p.relative_to(SUCC).as_posix()
        succ_files.add(rel)
for root, dirs, files in os.walk(FROZEN):
    for fn in files:
        p=Path(root)/fn
        rel=p.relative_to(FROZEN).as_posix()
        frozen_files.add(rel)

only_succ=sorted(succ_files-frozen_files)
only_frozen=sorted(frozen_files-succ_files)
common=succ_files & frozen_files
changed=[]
# hash common files; skip reviews tree for speed? We need complete picture. Hashing 12k files is ok.
for i,rel in enumerate(sorted(common)):
    sp=SUCC/rel
    fp=FROZEN/rel
    if sp.stat().st_size != fp.stat().st_size:
        changed.append(rel)
        continue
    if sha(sp)!=sha(fp):
        changed.append(rel)

print("succ_file_count", len(succ_files))
print("frozen_file_count", len(frozen_files))
print("only_succ_count", len(only_succ))
print("only_frozen_count", len(only_frozen))
print("size_or_hash_changed", len(changed))
print("ONLY_SUCC")
for r in only_succ:
    print(" ", r)
print("ONLY_FROZEN")
for r in only_frozen:
    print(" ", r)
print("CHANGED_NOT_IN_MANIFEST")
extra_changed=[r for r in changed if r not in MANIFEST_PATHS]
print("extra_changed_count", len(extra_changed))
for r in extra_changed:
    print(" ", r)
print("MANIFEST_NOT_CHANGED")
for r in sorted(MANIFEST_PATHS):
    if r not in only_succ and r not in changed:
        print(" ", r)
print("CHANGED_IN_MANIFEST", len([r for r in changed if r in MANIFEST_PATHS]))
